carotid-transverse.title: Transverse common carotid artery and internal jugular vein
carotid-transverse.label: Carotid and jugular vein in cross-section
carotid-transverse.credit: Sohan L. Solanki et al., Saudi Journal of Anaesthesia (2018), Figure 2b
carotid-transverse.reason: The acquired panel shows the round carotid artery beside the larger, lateral jugular vein.
carotid-transverse.note: Acquired transverse grayscale from a healthy volunteer study. The authors label the carotid artery and internal jugular vein. This panel’s side and exact neck level are unreported. Shared as a qualitative comparison on both modeled sides. Cropped to panel b without resizing or flipping. Noncommercial reuse under the same license.

carotid-longitudinal.title: Longitudinal right common carotid artery
carotid-longitudinal.label: Right common carotid in long axis
carotid-longitudinal.credit: Åsa Rydén Ahlgren, Tobias Erlöv and Magnus Cinthio, Physiological Reports (2023), Figure 1
carotid-longitudinal.reason: Compare the elongated lumen and parallel interfaces of the common carotid trunk.
carotid-longitudinal.note: Acquired right common carotid artery in a healthy volunteer study, about 2 cm proximal to the bifurcation. The published wall-interface markers are retained. Tight field around the vessel wall. Used as a qualitative long-axis reference for both routes, including the modeled left side. Converted without resizing or flipping.
